factory.name: PivotGrid.create | PivotFieldList.create
factory.signature: PivotGrid.create<Row>(host: HTMLElement, options: PivotGridOptions<Row>): PivotGrid<Row>; PivotFieldList.create<Row>(host: HTMLElement, options: PivotFieldListOptions<Row>): PivotFieldList; createLocalPivotSource<Row>(rows: readonly Row[], fields: readonly PivotField<Row>[], options?: { locale?: string }): LocalPivotSource<Row>; compareKeys(a: PivotKey, b: PivotKey, locale: string): number; downloadCsv(csv: string | Blob, filename: string, doc?: Document): void

options.name: caption
options.description: Visible <caption> and accessible name of the table and its scroll region (aria-labelledby). Non-empty.

options.name: hideCaption
options.description: Keep the caption for assistive technology only (visually hidden).

options.name: fields
options.description: Available fields: { id (unique; default row property), label, value?(row) (grouping or aggregation value; keys must be string | number | boolean | null, dates as ISO strings, other values converted to text), formatMember?(key) (member label), numberFormat? (Intl.NumberFormatOptions of aggregated values), areas? (allowed areas in the field list; default all), aggregate? (default when added to values; default 'sum') }. Changing it with update() revalidates the layout and reloads.

options.name: data
options.description: Records aggregated in the browser by the local engine (createLocalPivotSource). Exactly one of data or dataSource. Passing a new array with update() reloads; mutating the array in place needs reload().

options.name: dataSource
options.description: Server-side aggregation: { query(query, signal): Promise<{ cells }>; members(request, signal): Promise<{ members, total }> }. A query lists rowParents and columnParents; the answer holds one PivotCell { row, column, values } for every combination of a requested row path (each parent plus its children one level deeper) and a requested column path that has records. Results are validated (PIVOT_DATA_SOURCE). Exactly one of data or dataSource.

options.name: layout
options.description: { rows: fieldId[]; columns: fieldId[]; values: { field, aggregate: 'sum' | 'count' | 'average' | 'min' | 'max' | 'distinctCount' }[]; filters?: fieldId[]; include?: Record<fieldId, PivotKey[]> (included members; a missing field includes all); sort?: { rows?, columns? } (PivotSort: { by: 'label', direction } or { by: 'value', value (index into values), column? (row sort: the column path compared, default [] = grand total), direction }); expanded?: { rows: PivotKey[][]; columns: PivotKey[][] } | null }. A field appears at most once in rows, columns, and filters together, and at most once in values. Serializable: save the layout getter or aui-layout-change detail.layout.

options.name: virtual
options.description: Render only the rows in view (plus an overscan) with spacer rows; aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex keep the positions. The region gets max-block-size 70vh unless the page sets another.

options.name: rowHeight
options.description: Virtual mode row height estimate in CSS px (integer 16..200); replaced by the measured height after the first render.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: Body text when no record matches (default localized 'No data').

options.name: grandTotals
options.description: Grand total row (last), grand total column (last), both, or none. Without column fields the value columns are always shown.

options.name: columnSubtotals
options.description: A '{member} total' column after the children of each expanded column group. Row groups always show their subtotal on the group row (compact form).

options.name: expandDepth
options.description: Group levels expanded when the layout has no explicit `expanded` (integer 0..16; 0 = only the top level, the lazy-loading setting for servers). After loading, the expansion is explicit (layout.expanded).

options.name: requestTimeoutMs
options.description: Timeout of every data source request in ms (integer 100..600000); the request's signal is aborted with a TimeoutError.

options.name: stickyHeader
options.description: Column header rows stay visible while the region scrolls vertically (row headers always stick to the inline start).

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of number formatting, member order (Intl.Collator, numeric), search, and messages.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the collapsed-group chevron; columns follow the document direction through the table layout.

properties.name: layout
properties.description: The current layout (a serializable copy with explicit expanded paths).

properties.name: loading
properties.description: True while a data source request runs (the table has aria-busy=true).

properties.name: ready
properties.description: Resolves when the loads started by the last change finished (successfully or not).

properties.name: PivotFieldList.host
properties.description: The field list host (class aui-pivot-fields, role=group).

properties.name: PivotFieldList events
properties.description: The field list dispatches aui-field-move (bubbles, not cancelable) on its own host with PivotFieldMoveDetail { field; from: 'available' | PivotArea; to: 'available' | PivotArea; index } after a move or removal was applied to the grid.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (validated first). data, dataSource, fields, layout, or expandDepth reload from the data source; data and dataSource replace each other. No event.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Replace the layout (validated) and reload. A changed row, column, or value list resets the expansion to expandDepth (unless the layout has expanded). Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'layout', or 'filter' when only include changed).

methods.name: setFilter
methods.signature: setFilter(field: string, include: readonly PivotKey[] | null): void
methods.description: Set the included members of any field (null includes all) and reload. Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'filter').

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sort the members of an axis within each group by label or by a value (null: ascending labels). Blank members stay last. No reload. Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'sort').

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.signature: setExpanded(axis: 'rows' | 'columns', path: PivotPath, expanded: boolean): Promise<void>
methods.description: Expand or collapse a group; the first expansion queries its children (one delta query). On failure the group stays collapsed and 'The data could not be loaded.' is announced. Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'expand' / 'collapse').

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expand every group of an axis, level by level (one query per level), or collapse all. Emits aui-layout-change.

methods.name: members
methods.signature: members(field: string, options?: { search?: string; offset?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<PivotMembersResult & { labels: string[] }>
methods.description: A page of a field's members (filtered by the other fields' filters) through the data source, with display labels. limit 1..10000 (default 100). Emits aui-load-error and rejects on failure.

methods.name: memberLabel
methods.description: Display label: the field's formatMember, else localized '(blank)' for null, locale digits for numbers, or the text.

methods.name: valueLabel
methods.description: Header of a value field, for example 'Sum of Amount'.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Discard loaded cells and reload everything (keeps the expansion). The Retry button in the error state calls it.

methods.name: toMatrix
methods.description: The visible pivot as data: rows (path, labels, kind), columns split by value (path, labels, kind, value, valueLabel), and values[row][column] (null where empty). Feed it to charts.

methods.name: toCsv
methods.description: CSV (RFC 4180) of the visible pivot: one column per row field with member labels, then one per visible value column ('Q1 / Sum of Amount'). Formula injection is escaped (escapeFormulas, default true); numbers are trusted. Options: values, delimiter, lineEnding, bom, escapeFormulas. Save it with downloadCsv.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort requests, remove the region, classes, and listeners.

methods.name: PivotFieldList.update
methods.description: Merge label, memberPageSize, locale, direction; re-render (cancels a move).

methods.name: PivotFieldList.destroy
methods.description: Remove the lists, listeners, role, and host class.

events.name: aui-layout-change
events.description: The layout changed through the UI, the field list, or a method (not through update()). Save detail.layout. Dispatched on the grid host.

events.name: aui-load-error
events.description: A data source request failed, timed out, or returned an invalid result. A failed initial load shows 'The data could not be loaded.' with a Retry button. Superseded requests do not report.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot
cssClasses.description: Grid host; aui-pivot--compact | --comfortable | --spacious, --sticky, --virtual.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__region
cssClasses.description: Focusable, labelled scroll region (role=region, tabindex=0). Set max-block-size on it to keep headers in view.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__table | __caption | __head | __body
cssClasses.description: The table and its parts; aui-pivot__caption--hidden hides the caption visually.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__corner
cssClasses.description: Top-left header (row field names) with the label sort button; aria-sort.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__col-header | --total
cssClasses.description: Column member headers (scope col/colgroup, colspan/rowspan) and subtotal/grand total headers.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__value-header | --total
cssClasses.description: Value headers ('Sum of Amount') with value sort buttons; aria-sort.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__row | --group | --total
cssClasses.description: Body rows: expanded group rows and the grand total row.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__row-header
cssClasses.description: Row header cell (th scope=row); indentation from --aui-pivot-level (set through the CSSOM).

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__path
cssClasses.description: Visually hidden group path inside nested row headers ('North, ').

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__cell | --total
cssClasses.description: Data cell (headers attribute lists every header id); totals are semibold.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__toggle | __toggle-icon
cssClasses.description: Expand/collapse button (aria-expanded; aria-busy while loading).

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__sort | __sort-label | __sort-icon
cssClasses.description: Sort buttons in the corner and value headers.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__status | --error | __retry
cssClasses.description: Loading, empty, no-values, and error states; Retry button.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot__spacer
cssClasses.description: Virtual mode spacer rows (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot-fields
cssClasses.description: Field list host (role=group).

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot-fields__areas | __area | __area--available | --filters | --columns | --rows | --values | __title | __list
cssClasses.description: The five labelled lists.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot-fields__entry | --grabbed | --dragging | __label | __empty | __marker
cssClasses.description: Field entries, grabbed/dragged state, empty-list text, drop marker.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot-fields__handle | __aggregate | __filter | --active | __remove
cssClasses.description: Move handle (aria-pressed), aggregate select, filter toggle (aria-expanded), remove button.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot-fields__panel | __search | __members | __member-list | __member | __status | __more | __actions | __select-all | __clear | __apply | __cancel
cssClasses.description: Member filter panel.

cssClasses.name: aui-pivot-fields__instructions | __sr
cssClasses.description: Visible move instructions (aria-describedby of each handle); visually hidden text.
